messages:
alyssa: Quick sync — follow-ups from last week's postmortem (search-slo-regression). Need owners for each action, Jira links, RACI clarity, and timelines. Can we do a 10-min scrub?

mike: I can drive the infra action. I'll create a Jira and tag @samir for investigation. ETA end of sprint (2w).

samir: assigned. I'll look into the KV cache GC pattern that caused the spike. Observed recurring bump ~every 3 weeks. Logging a hypothesis now.

jordan: I'll own the runbook update + tiny playbook for oncall. Will add step-by-step and rollback notes. ETA Thurs.

hua: For RACI: infra = R, samir = A, jordan = C, alyssa = I? propose that.

alyssa: Sounds good — can you add the RACI as a comment on each Jira ticket so we don't lose it?

mike: created JIRA-4582: "Investigate KV GC spike + mitigation" link: https://rwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-4582 — added samir, jordan as watchers, put labels: postmortem, recurring.

samir: thanks. I posted initial logs snippet:
```
# kv gc waiter timeline
tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/kvgc.log | grep GC
2025-05-06 02:12:09 GC sweep started ...
```

jordan: added runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/233 — includes playbook steps and paging thresholds.

alyssa: Quick ask: can we get an explicit timeline for each ticket (triage -> fix -> rollout -> post-verify)? Put target dates in Jira.

mike: updated JIRA-4582 with dates: triage 5/9, fix 5/16, rollout 5/20, post-verify 5/27.

samir: Flag: fix might need a kernel tweak that could slip a week. I'll note in the ticket and add contingency.

alyssa: OK add a fallback policy: if kernel tweak slips, enable short-term prefix caching tweak as temporary mitigation and mark owner.

mike: wrote mitigation task JIRA-4583 and assigned to jordan for rollout of caching change.

jordan: will deploy caching tweak to canary and monitor latency+cost.

ops-rotation-bot: Reminder — oncall handoff tomorrow 09:00 UTC. @samir you'll be oncall for infra this rotation.

samir: noted. I'll add an incident watch on the canary for 72h post-rollout.

alyssa: For recurring patterns: can we add a weekly checkpoint in the postmortem doc to track recurrence count and if pattern persists escalate to a Reliability Deep Dive?

mike: agree. I've added a checklist in the postmortem doc and a calendar invite for weekly 15-min check-ins for 4 weeks.

alyssa: Great. Last thing — can everyone confirm they updated their Jira tickets and put RACI + owner + target dates? Reply with :thumbsup: once done.

samir: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup:

hua: :thumbsup:

alyssa: thanks all. I'll close the loop in 48h and escalate if any ticket missing owners.

incident-bot: Postmortem "search-slo-regression" linked: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/search-slo-regression-2025-05-06

alyssa: filing final check — if nothing else, we'll treat JIRA-4582 and JIRA-4583 as high priority for the sprint and flag in Monday's sync. Thanks everyone.
